title: lichen-rpl routing.rs doc comment claims sender-to-target authorization precedes replay check; code runs it after
description: Found by kimi-k3 security review of b7z9.3.1 (pre-existing, not introduced by that diff). rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:564-565 doc comment on process_signature_verified claims sender-to-target authorization 'precedes replay', but sender_is_authorized runs at routing.rs:669, after the replay check at routing.rs:627-640. The comment contradicts the code on exactly the ordering property the R-05-035 flags rejection relies on (replay classification before semantic parse). Fix: correct the doc comment (replay classification precedes prefix authorization and sender authorization; semantic parse precedes route-state mutation only), or reorder the code if the comment reflects the intended spec semantics — check spec/05-routing.md 8.6/8.7 ordering requirements first and pick whichever matches. Files: rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.3.1.
